### HB1784 (2024)

- **Policy ID:** `hi-hb1784-2024`
- **Sponsor / party:** Rep. Lisa Kitagawa; D
- **Recorded status:** Passed House 2024-03-01; Senate passed second reading as SD1 and referred to WAM 2024-03-20. Complete official history retained2026-11-05 records no later final passage. LRB reports actual regular-session sine die on 2024-05-03; ArticleIIIsection15 carries pending bills only from an odd-year regular session into the next regular session. Infer nonpassage at the end of the 2024 regular-session biennium, not present pendency. This is a historical session-outcome inference, not a bill-specific Died entry or absence-of-successor-law claim.
- **Provisions:** HB1784 SD1 proposed temporarily reinstating and expanding the technology infrastructure renovation tax credit to include data servers, for taxable years beginning after 2024-12-31 through those beginning on or before 2027-12-31.
- **Mechanism / scope:** incentive_support; fiscal
- **Legal effect:** failed
- **Effective date:** —
- **End condition and limitations:** HB1784 SD1 proposed no credit for taxable years beginning after 2027-12-31; this is a proposed eligibility cutoff, not an enacted instrument sunset.
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://www.capitol.hawaii.gov/session/archives/measure_indiv_Archives.aspx?billnumber=1784&billtype=HB&year=2024>)

### HR196 (2026)

- **Policy ID:** `hi-hr196-2026`
- **Sponsor / party:** Reps. Nicole Lowen, Terez Amato, Della Au Belatti, Tina Grandinetti, Jeanne Kapela, Sue Keohokapu-Lee Loy, Matthias Kusch, Lisa Marten, Tyson Miyake, Amy Perruso, Mahina Poepoe, Shirley Ann Templo, Chris Todd; D
- **Recorded status:** Adopted by the House in final form 2026-04-09 (House-only resolution; no Senate action required)

- **Mechanism / scope:** other; state_agency
- **Legal effect:** unknown
